adjudication.rationale: In the newly added shared UI component `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the remove button tooltip is hardcoded as `content="Remove email"` instead of using `t(...)`, while the rest of user-facing strings in the component use translations (e.g., `t("add_another")`). This results in an untranslated English tooltip for non-English locales in an exported, reusable `@calcom/ui` component.
